cookItems.name: Plain basmati rice
cookItems.instructions: Rinse rice 2-3 times. 1:1.5 water ratio. Boil, cover, lowest heat 15 min. Fluff. Cool COMPLETELY before portioning — never seal hot rice.
cookItems.storageNote: Reheat with 1 tbsp water, microwave 2 min covered.

cookItems.name: Hard-boiled eggs
cookItems.instructions: Cold water start. Bring to boil. 10 min. Ice bath 5 min. Store IN SHELL — never peel until eating. Cook 10 this week instead of 8 — one extra egg added to daal dinners.
cookItems.storageNote: Store in egg carton. In shell only. Do not peel ahead.

cookItems.name: Saag (mustard greens + spinach)
cookItems.instructions: Wash and roughly chop greens. Cook until completely soft (pressure cooker 15 min or stovetop 25 min). Blend lightly. Add ginger-garlic paste, haldi. Store plain. Add fresh zeera-garlic tarka + tiny knob of ghee EACH TIME you reheat — makes it taste just made.
cookItems.storageNote: Tastes better day 2 and 3. Always add ghee tarka when reheating.

cookItems.name: Whole wheat rotis — first batch
cookItems.instructions: Make dough: 400g atta + water + pinch salt. Rest 20 min. Roll thin. Cook on hot dry tawa 45 sec each side. Stack and wrap in cloth while hot. Foil-wrap pairs of 2 when cool.
cookItems.storageNote: Reheat on dry tawa 30-45 sec per side. Or microwave 30 sec in damp paper towel.

cookItems.name: Chicken karahi base
cookItems.instructions: Onion-tomato masala: ginger-garlic, zeera, haldi, lal mirch. 1 tbsp oil. Cook until oil separates and masala is thick and coating chicken. Dry style — no water.
cookItems.storageNote: Reheat in pan with 2 tbsp water on low.

cookItems.name: Aloo gosht (lamb and potato)
cookItems.instructions: Brown lamb in 1 tbsp oil. Add onion-tomato masala, zeera, haldi, ginger-garlic. Pressure cook 20 min. Add cubed potato, 10 more min. Skim excess oil.
cookItems.storageNote: Better day 2+. Reheat in pan with lid and 2 tbsp water.

cookItems.name: Masoor daal
cookItems.instructions: Cook with haldi and salt until soft. Garlic-zeera tarka: heat 1 tsp oil, add 4 garlic slices + 1 tsp zeera until golden. Add half now, save half for reheating.
cookItems.storageNote: Add 3 tbsp water when reheating. Fresh garlic tarka each time.

cookItems.name: Plain basmati rice
cookItems.instructions: Rinse rice 2-3 times. 1:1.5 water ratio. Boil, cover, lowest heat 15 min. Fluff. Cool COMPLETELY before portioning — never seal hot rice.
cookItems.storageNote: Reheat with 1 tbsp water, microwave 2 min covered.

cookItems.name: Hard-boiled eggs
cookItems.instructions: Cold water start. Bring to boil. 10 min. Ice bath 5 min. Store IN SHELL — never peel until eating. Cook 10 this week instead of 8 — one extra egg added to daal dinners.
cookItems.storageNote: Store in egg carton. In shell only. Do not peel ahead.

cookItems.name: Saag (mustard greens + spinach)
cookItems.instructions: Wash and roughly chop greens. Cook until completely soft (pressure cooker 15 min or stovetop 25 min). Blend lightly. Add ginger-garlic paste, haldi. Store plain. Add fresh zeera-garlic tarka + tiny knob of ghee EACH TIME you reheat — makes it taste just made.
cookItems.storageNote: Tastes better day 2 and 3. Always add ghee tarka when reheating.

cookItems.name: Whole wheat rotis — first batch
cookItems.instructions: Make dough: 400g atta + water + pinch salt. Rest 20 min. Roll thin. Cook on hot dry tawa 45 sec each side. Stack and wrap in cloth while hot. Foil-wrap pairs of 2 when cool.
cookItems.storageNote: Reheat on dry tawa 30-45 sec per side. Or microwave 30 sec in damp paper towel.

cookItems.name: Chicken karahi base
cookItems.instructions: Final week. Same dry masala method. System mastered.
cookItems.storageNote: Reheat with 2 tbsp water.

cookItems.name: Aloo gosht (lamb and potato)
cookItems.instructions: Same as Week 1. Brown lamb, masala, pressure cook 20 min, add potato, 10 more min.
cookItems.storageNote: Better day 2+. Low heat reheat.

cookItems.name: Masoor daal
cookItems.instructions: Final week. Same reliable method. Haldi, salt, garlic-zeera tarka.
cookItems.storageNote: Add water and fresh tarka when reheating.
